Quality assurance standards and environmental management standards
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation provides rules relating to the quality standards and environmental management systems and standards. These standards should be based on relevant European standards and certified by accredited bodies.
heading_path: Quality assurance standards and environmental management standards
Overview
Quality assurance standards and environmental management standards
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Where the contracting authority requires certification of certain quality assurance systems and environmental management standards, it should ensure that these are based on relevant European standards and certified by accredited bodies.
